responsibility: Is the main implementation file of the S/390 backend. It owns target hooks, processor cost tables, register and mode legality, addressing and PIC handling, prologue/epilogue generation, calling convention details, compare and branch expansion, atomic and transactional-memory expansion, vector and string-operation helpers, asm output hooks, option-dependent behavior, and the final TARGET_INITIALIZER wiring that connects System z code generation to GCC’s middle and back ends.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name s390 files, this is the runtime backend implementation file: it defines target-hook functions, cost tables, and TARGET_INITIALIZER wiring. In contrast, s390.h provides compile-time macros/data structures, s390.md provides RTL pattern rules, and s390.opt declares option syntax and storage.
